text: Attach to a minion. Otherwise, Psionic Shield gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion would leave play, instead heal all damage from that minion. Then, discard this attachment.

name: Acolyte Frenzy
text:
When Revealed: Each [[ACOLYTE]] minion engaged with you activates against you. If you are not engaged with an [[ACOLYTE]] minion, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: You are stunned and confused.

name: Rogue
text: Skin Contact − Action: Attach Touched to another character. You gain each of the attached character's [[TRAITS]] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.) Forced Response: After the player phase begins, find Touched and set it aside.

flavor: "You couldn't live mah life."
name: Anna Marie
text: Setup: Set your Touched upgrade aside. Withdrawn − Forced Response: After you change to this form, set Touched aside.

name: Touched
text:
If Touched is attached to a:
Minion − Rogue's attacks gain overkill.
Villain − Rogue gains retaliate 1.
Ally − Rogue gains the [[AERIAL]] trait.
Hero − Rogue gains stalwart.

name: Gambit
text: Gambit enters play with 3 charge counters on him. [star] Interrupt: When Gambit attacks, remove 1 charge counter from him → deal 1 damage to an enemy.

name: Rogue's Jacket
text:
While Touched is attached to a friendly character, Rogue gets +1 THW.
While Touched is attached to a enemy character, Rogue gets +1 ATK.

name: Goin' Rogue
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If Rogue has: • [[AERIAL]], remove 2 additional threat. • Retaliate, confuse an enemy. • Stalwart, draw 1 card.

name: Southern Cross
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If Rogue has: • [[AERIAL]], this attack deals 2 additional damage. • Retaliate, stun that enemy. • Stalwart, draw 1 card.

name: Energy Transfer
text: Hero Action: Attach Touched to a character other than Rogue and deal 2 damage to that character → heal 2 damage from Rogue and ready her. You gain each of the attached character's [[TRAITS]] until the end of the round.

name: Bulletproof Belle
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy with Touched attached to it attacks, prevent all damage from that attack and gain a tough status card.

name: Superpower Adaptation
text: Hero Action: If Touched is attached to a friendly character, search its owner's discard pile for an event that belong's to the same classification as that character (identity-specific, aspect, or basic) → add that event to your hand.

name: Iceman
text: Iceman enters play with 3 freeze counters on him. Response: After a minion enters play, remove 1 freeze counter from Iceman → stun that minion.

name: Karma
text: Response: After you play Karma from your hand, choose a non-[[ELITE]] minion. While Karma is in play, take control of that minion and treat it as a [[CONTROLLED]] ally with a blank text box. Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 2 consequential damage after it thwarts or attacks.

flavor: "Good luck getting through my impenetrable psionic exoskeleton."
name: Armor
text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-MEN]] trait.
Toughness.

name: Unflappable
text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you defend against an attack and take no damage, exhaust Unflappable → draw 1 card.

name: Judoka Skill
text: Uses (3 judo counters). Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When you defend against an enemy attack, remove 1 judo counter from here → that enemy gets -2 ATK for that attack.

name: Preemptive Strike
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a boost card is turned face up while the villain attacks, cancel all boost icons ([boost]) on that card. Then deal 1 damage to the villain for each boost icon cancelled this way.

name: Not Today!
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When your hero defends against an attack, it gets +2 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

name: Defensive Energy
text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When you spend this card to play a [[Defense]] event, draw 1 card.

name: Moira MacTaggert
text: Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Response: After a [[MUTANT]] alter-ego changes into hero form, exhaust Moira MacTaggert → that hero's controller draws 1 card.

name: X-Gene
text: Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Max 1 per player Resource: Exhaust X-Gene → generate a [wild] resource for an identity-specific event.

name: Beauty and the Thief
text: Team-Up (Gambit and Rogue). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. Remove 4 threat from a scheme.

name: Energy
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Genius
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Strength
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Deadly Touch
text: Give to the Anna Marie player • If Touched is attached to a friendly character, deal 2 damage to that character. Discard this card. • If Touched is not attached to a friendly character, place 2 threat on the main scheme. Discard this card.

name: Mystique
text: Toughness. Villainous. Forced Response: After Mystique engages you, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for a copy of the Misled treachery and shuffle it into your deck.

flavor: While she knows Mystique can't be trusted, Rogue still finds it hard to reject the woman who raised her.
name: Mystique's Manipulations
text: When Defeated: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Misled treachery and shuffle it into your deck.

name: Misled
text: When Revealed: Shuffle this card into your deck. This card gains surge. Forced Response: After this card enters your hand, place 2 threat on the main scheme. (You may discard this card from your hand at the end of the player phase like any other card.)

name: Med Lab
text: Max 1 per player. Response: After an ally is defeated by consequential damage, exhaust Med Lab → place it here. (Limit 1 ally at a time.) Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Med Lab → play the ally here as if it was in your hand. It enters play exhausted.

name: Donald Pierce
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Villainous. Forced Response: After Donald Pierce engages you, reveal the topmost [[REAVER]] minion from the discard pile.

flavor: "Who you gonna call?"
name: Skullbuster
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Toughness. Forced Response: After Skullbuster engages you, place 1 threat on the main scheme for each [[REAVER]] minion engaged with you.

flavor: "Bonebreaker's ready!"
name: Bonebreaker
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Toughness. Forced Response: After Bonebreaker engages you, take 1 indirect damage for each [[REAVER]] minion engaged with you.

name: Wade Cole
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Cybernetic Enhancements attachment and attach it to Wade Cole. (Shuffle.)

name: Murray Reese
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Cybernetic Enhancements attachment and attach it to Murray Reese. (Shuffle.)

name: The Reavers
text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme discards cards from the encounter deck until a [[REAVER]] minion is discarded, then reveals that minion.

name: Cybernetic Enhancements
text: Attach to a minion. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion cannot take damage. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion attacks, discard Cybernetic Enhancements.

name: MaGog
text: [star] Forced Response: After MaGog attacks and damages a character, place 1 ratings counter on The Champion. Forced Interrupt: When MaGog would be defeated, reset his hit points to 10[per_hero] instead. Place 3[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and deal each player 1 facedown encounter card.

name: MaGog
text: [star] Forced Response: After MaGog attacks and damages a character, place 2 ratings counters on The Champion. Forced Interrupt: When MaGog would be defeated, reset his hit points to 10[per_hero] instead. Place 2[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and deal each player 1 facedown encounter card.

name: Melee in the Mojo-seum
text: Contents: MaGog (A) (MaGog (B) instead for expert mode). MaGog and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (1 random modular set from the MojoMania scenario pack). Setup: Put The Champion environment card and The Challengers environment card into play, each with its [[BOOING CROWD]] side faceup.

flavor: Teleported into a bizarre arena, you must fight for the audience's entertainment...and your lives!
name: Melee in the Mojo-seum
text: The players cannot win the game unless they wow the crowd as The Challengers. [star] Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed, place 2[per_hero] ratings counters on The Champion and remove all threat from here instead.

flavor: "In this corner, we have your ninety-nine time defending Mojoverse champion, the mighty MaGog!"
name: The Champion
text: If there are at least 5[per_hero] ratings counters here, flip this environment (without removing ratings counters).

name: The Champion
text: Underdogs — Forced Response: After The Champion flips to this side, each player draws 1 card. If there are at least 10[per_hero] ratings counters here, MaGog wins again and the players lose the game.

flavor: "And in this corner, hailing from the tiny, insignificant planet of Earth, we have our challengers!" —Mojo
name: The Challengers
text: If there are at least 5[per_hero] ratings counters here, flip this environment (without removing ratings counters). (The players wow the crowd by placing ratings counters here.)

name: The Challengers
text: Tag Team — Forced Response: After The Challengers flips to this side, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Surprise Contender and put it into play engaged with the first player. If it is already in play, give it a tough status card. If there are at least 10[per_hero] ratings counters here, you wow the crowd and the players win the game.

name: Jolt of Adrenaline
text:
Attach to MaGog. MaGog gains retaliate 1 and stalwart. Forced Response: After MaGog's hit points are reset, place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Surge of Aggression
text:
Attach to MaGog. Forced Response: After MaGog's hit points are reset, place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Surprise Contender
text: Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Surprise Contender attacks and damages a character, place 1 ratings counters on The Champion. When Defeated: Place 2[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers.

flavor: "Do you smell what MaGog is cooking?" —MaGog
name: Pump Up the Crowd
text: When Revealed: If The Champion is on its [[Cheering Crowd]] side, place an additional 1[per_hero] threat here. When Defeated: Place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers.

name: Break a Leg
text: When Revealed: You are stunned. Take 2 damage (4 damage instead there are more ratings counters on The Challengers than on The Champion). You may place any number of ratings counters on The Champion to reduce this damage by 1 for each counter placed this way.

flavor: "Are you not entertained?" —MaGog
name: Defend the Title
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place 2 ratings counters on The Champion. When Revealed (Hero): MaGog attacks you. If a hero defends against this attacks and takes no damage, place 2 ratings counters on The Challengers.

name: Stage Fright
text:
When Revealed: You are confused. Place 2 threat on the main scheme (4 threat instead if there are more ratings counters on The Challengers than on The Champion).
[star] Boost: You are confused.

name: Spiral
text: Spiral cannot take damage or be stunned. Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Spiral would attack, she schemes instead.

name: Spiral
text: If there are at least 3[per_hero] teleport counters here, remove all of them and flip Spiral. [star] Forced Response: After Spiral activates, place 1 teleport counter here.

name: Spiral
text: Spiral cannot take damage or be stunned. Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Spiral would attack, she schemes instead.

name: Spiral
text: If there are at least 2[per_hero] teleport counters here, remove all of them and flip Spiral. [star] Forced Response: After Spiral activates, place 1 teleport counter here.

name: Spiral
text: Spiral cannot take damage or be stunned. Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Spiral would attack, she schemes instead.

name: Spiral
text: If there are at least 3[per_hero] teleport counters here, remove all of them and flip Spiral. When Revealed: Spiral attacks each player in player order (even in alter-ego form). [star] Forced Response: After Spiral activates, place 1 teleport counter here.

name: Across the Mojoverse
text: Contents: Spiral (I) and Spiral (II) (Spiral (II) and Spiral (III) instead for expert mode). Spiral and Standard encounter sets. Three modular encounter sets from the MojoMania scenario pack. Setup: Put The Search for Spiral side scheme and 1 random [[SHOW]] environment into play. Shuffle each other [[SHOW]] environment together with the Cornered! treachery to create the show deck. (See rulebook p. 11). Flip Spiral to her [[ESCAPED]] side.

flavor: If you want to return home, you'll need the help of the teleporting sorceress, Spiral. But she will need some convincing.
name: Across the Mojoverse
text: Forced Interrupt: When a [[SHOW]] environment would be discarded, place it on the bottom of the show deck instead. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: Spiral is hiding in one of the numerous television programs Mojo is producing.
name: The Search for Spiral
text: Permanent. Forced Interrupt: After the last threat is removed from here, the player who removed that threat reveals the top card of the show deck and places 3[per_hero] threat here. Hero Action: Take 2 damage → remove 3 threat from here.

flavor: "Why won't you just leave me alone?!?" —Spiral
name: Cornered!
text: When Revealed: Flip Spiral to her [[Cornered]] side. (This will cause her "When Revealed" text, if any, to resolve.) Reveal the top card of the show deck. Shuffle this card into the show deck. This effect cannot be canceled.)

flavor: "Don't know how she keep from losin' an arm." —Gambit
name: Spiral's Swords
text: Attach to Spiral. Uses (3 sword counters). [star] Spiral gets +1 ATK for each sword counter on this card. Hero Action: If Spiral is on her [[Cornered]] side, spend [physical] [physical] resources → remove 1 sword counter from this card.

name: Erratic Teleportation
text: Surge. When Revealed: If Spiral is on her [[Cornered]] side, place 1 teleport counter on her. If Spiral is on her [[Escaped]] side, you may spend a [mental] resource to look at the top card of the show deck and put it on the top or bottom of that deck.

name: The Show Must Go On
text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a card from the same encounter set as the current [[Show]] environment and deals that card to themself as a facedown encounter card. (Shuffle.)

name: Well-Armed
text: When Revealed: If a copy of Spiral's Sword is attached to Spiral, she attacks you (even if you are in alter-ego form). Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Spiral's Sword and attach it to her. (Shuffle.)

name: Mojo
text: Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

name: Mojo
text: When Revealed: Place 2 threat on each friendly character. Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

name: Mojo
text: When Revealed: Place 3 threat on each friendly character. Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

name: MojoMania
text: Contents: Mojo (I) and Mojo (II) (Mojo (II) and Mojo (III) instead for expert mode). Mojo and Standard encounter sets. Setup: Choose 1 modular set, plus 1[per_hero] additional modular sets, from the MojoMania scenario pack and set them aside. Put the Wheel of Genres environment into play, [[SPINNING]] side faceup.

name: MojoMania
text: When Revealed: Choose 1 set-aside encounter set at random, reveal its [[SHOW]] environment and shuffle its remaining cards into the encounter deck. Forced Interrupt: When a character flips or leaves play, move all threat from that character to this scheme. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: "The ratings are stagnating. Time to shake things up with a crossover episode!" —Mojo
name: Wheel of Genres
text: Forced Response: After the encounter deck resets, if there are no set-aside modular encounter sets remaining, the players lose the game. Otherwise, flip this card.

name: Wheel of Genres
text: Forced Interrupt: At the start of step three of the villain phase (deal encounter cards), randomly choose 1 set-aside modular set and reveal its [[SHOW]] environment. Shuffle the rest of that modular set and place it on top of the encounter deck. Deal the first player 2 facedown encounter cards and flip this card.

flavor: "I live to serve, Your Supreme Spinelessness."
name: Major Domo
text: Attach to Mojo. [star] Forced Response: After Mojo attacks, discard cards from the encounter deck equal to the amount of damage dealt by that attack. Hero Action: Spend [energy] [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.

name: Stinger Tail
text:
Attach to Mojo. Mojo gains retaliate 2. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Mojo, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard Stinger Tail.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Mojo.

flavor: "They're cheaper than real actors." —Mojo
name: Supporting Actor
text:
[star] Forced Response: After Supporting Actor activates against you, place 2 threat here.
Boost: Place 1 threat on each character you control.

name: Paparazzi
text: Hinder 10. Action: Choose to either exhaust a character you control or discard 1 card from your hand → remove 2 threat from here (3 threat instead if you are in alter-ego form). Forced Interrupt: When your turn ends, move all threat from here to the main scheme and discard this card.

flavor: "They'll never recognize me." —Mojo
name: Undercover Mojo
text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Interrupt: When Mojo would take any amount of damage, remove an equal amount of threat from here instead.

name: Curtain Call
text:
When Revealed: Move all threat from the character with the most threat on it to the main scheme. If no threat was moved this way, place 1 threat on each character you control.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Director's Directions
text: When Revealed: Choose one: • Spend 2 different resources. • Mojo schemes. • Take 1 damage for each threat on your identity. If you take less than 2 damage this way, this card gains surge.

name: Top Billing
text:
When Revealed: Heal 1 damage from each character you control. Place 2 threat on each character you control.
[star] Boost: Place 1 threat on each character you control.

name: Dial M for Mojo
text: Each other encounter card gains incite 1. Each friendly character gets +1 THW. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

name: Build the Case
text: Forced Response: After a side scheme is defeated, place 1 clue counter here. Then, if there are at least 3 clue counters here, discard this card.

flavor:
"It seems the victim's luck ran out."
"I guess you could say he...lost his mojo." —Detectives Domo and Mojo
name: Crime Scene Investigation
text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) Threat cannot be removed from other schemes. Hero Action: Spend X [mental] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.

flavor: "I hold both of me in contempt!" —Judge Mojo
name: Law & Order
text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) Each friendly character gets -2 ATK. Hero Action: Spend X [energy] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.

flavor: "I was never here." —Boss Mojo
name: Dragnet
text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) The villain cannot take damage. Hero Action: Spend X [physical] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.

name: Elementary, My Dear Mojo
text: When Revealed: Choose one: • Move all threat from a side scheme to the main scheme.(That side scheme is defeated.) • Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that card.

name: A Game of Mojo's
text: Each player gets +1 hand size. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

name: Dragon
text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. Double the amount of damage this minion takes from cards with a printed [energy] resource. When Defeated: Each player draws 4 cards.

name: Goblin
text: Surge. This minion can only take damage from cards with a printed [physical] resource. When Defeated: Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

name: Troll
text: Toughness. This minion takes 1 additional damage from each card with a printed [mental] resource. When Defeated: The player who defeated this minion may put 1 ally from their discard pile into play.

errata: Replaced “for free” with “ignoring its resource cost”. (RRG 1.5)
flavor: "Bring me a shrubbery!" —Sir Mojo
name: Fetch Quest
text:
Surge. When Defeated: In player order, each player may search their deck for a card and play that card, ignoring its resource cost. (Shuffle.)
[star] Boost: Put this card into play.

name: Mana Drain
text:
When Revealed: Choose a non-wild (non-[wild]) resource type, then each player draws 2 cards. Each player must discard each card from their hand with the chosen resource type.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 card from your hand.

name: The Mojo Files
text: Each minion gains quickstrike. Each ally takes -1 consequential damage ([cost]) after attacking a minion. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

name: Bandolier of Stakes
text: Surge. Uses (3 stake counters).When Revealed: You may spend 1 resource of any type to attach this card to your identity. Otherwise, discard this card. Hero Interrupt: When your hero makes a basic attack, remove 1 stake counter from here → your hero gets +1 ATK for that attack and that attack gains piercing.

flavor: "Release the kraken!"
name: Cultist
text: [star] Forced Response: After Cultist activates against you, search the encounter deck and discard pile for The Kraken and put it into play engaged with you. (Shuffle.) Then, discard Cultist.

flavor: "Rraaarhh!"
name: The Kraken
text: [star] Forced Response: After The Kraken activates, each other character takes 1 damage. When Defeated: Each friendly character heals 1 damage.

name: Vampire
text: Attacks with piercing deal double damage to Vampire. [star] Forced Response: After Vampire attacks and damages a character, heal all damage from Vampire. If no damage was healed this way, give Vampire a tough status card.

name: Werewolf Pack
text: When Revealed: Defeat an ally you control and place it facedown under Werewolf Pack. Forced Interrupt: When Werewolf Pack would be defeated, discard an ally from under it instead. Then, heal all damage from Werewolf Pack.

flavor:
">Password accepted. Logging you into the server now.
>Welcome to MojoCorp! Your activities will be monitored."
name: Mojo Runner
text: Each minion and ally gains toughness. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

flavor: ">Deallocatting CPU cycles from unidentified process."
name: Avalanche 9.0
text:
Forced Response: After Avalanche 9.0 engages you, exhaust a character you control and deal 1 damage to this character.
[star] Boost: Exhaust a character you control.

flavor:
">Buffering...
>Buffering...
>Buffering..."
name: Blob 3.14
text:
Blob 3.14 cannot take more than 2 damage from each attack.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

flavor: ">Reformating infected hard drive."
name: Magneto 2.6
text: Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Magneto 2.6 activates against you, place 1 magnetic counter on him. Then, choose and discard 1 card from your hand for each magnetic counter on Magneto 2.6.

flavor: ">Purging unknown program."
name: Pyro 4.0
text:
[star] Forced Interrupt: When Pyro 4.0 attacks you, take 2 indirect damage.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.

flavor: ">Quarantining dangerous subroutine."
name: Toad 2.0
text: Forced Response: After Toad 2.0 engages you, place 1 upgrade you control facedown under Toad 2.0. When Defeated: Return each card under Toad 2.0 to its owner's hand.

flavor:
">Invasive programs detected.
>Intrusion Counter Electronics deployed."
name: ICE-Teroid M
text: Each minion gains guard and patrol. Forced Interrupt: At the end of the round (after the first player token is passed), the first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a minion and puts it into play engaged with them. (Shuffle.)

name: Mojo in the Middle
text: Each obligation gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]). Response: After a player discards an obligation, that player draws 1 card. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

flavor:
"I'll never be like you!"
"You're my clone!" —X-23 and Wolverine
name: Family Matters
text: Treat the printed text box of each support you control as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity and each support you control → discard this obligation.

flavor: "It's not my fault!" —Hope Summers
name: Growing Pains
text: Increase the cost to play each of your upgrades by 2. Alter-Ego Action: Discard an upgrade you control or discard an upgrade from your hand. If you have more upgrades in your discard pile than in play, discard this obligation.

flavor: "I'll clean it up later." —Jubilee
name: The Odd Couple
text: Reduce your ally limit by 2. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust 2 characters you control → shuffle an ally from your discard pile into your deck and discard this obligation.

name: The One with the Breakup
text: Each encounter card gains peril. Alter-Ego Action: Discard 3 cards from your hand and choose a player → the chosen player draws 1 card and you discard this obligation.

flavor: "What does 'you' mean again?!" —Deadpool
name: Watch Me Play
text: Incite 3. Peril. Forced Interrupt: When you look up a rule, you are confused. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity and discard a confused status card from it → discard this obligation.

name: Wild Wild Mojo
text: Each enemy attack gains overkill. Forced Interrupt: When a character takes damage, increase that damage by 1. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

name: Dead or Alive
text: Attach to the minion with the highest printed hit points. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +3[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion is defeated, each player adds 1 card from their discard pile to their hand.

flavor: All he does is swim and eat and win at cards.
name: Card Shark
text: [star] Forced Response: After Card Shark attacks you, discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Take indirect damage equal to the number of different printed resources types ([energy], [mental], [physical], or [wild]) discarded this way.

flavor: "Draw!"
name: Gunslinger
text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When this minion engages you (before resolving quickstrike), you may spend [energy][energy] resources. If you do, deal damage to this minion equal to your hero's ATK.

flavor: When you play a game of cards, you win or lose...
name: A Game of Cards
text: When Revealed: Draw 5 cards. Choose and discard 5 cards from your hand. For each different printed resource type ([energy], [mental], [physical], or [wild]) discarded this way, discard an upgrade or support you control.

name: Longshot
text: [star] Longshot's attacks gain piercing. Longshot does not count against your ally limit. When Revealed: Put Longshot into play under your control. This card gains surge. This effect cannot be canceled.

flavor: "The battle may be won, but the war is far from over."
name: Cable
text: Response: After Cable defeats a side scheme, ready him. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Nathan Summers
text: You may include player side schemes from any aspect in your deck. Soldier X — Setup: Search your deck and discard pile for a player side scheme and put it into play. (Shuffle.)

name: Bodyslide
text: Action: Change form. Each other player may change to the form you are in.

name: Mind Scan
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each side scheme in the victory display.

name: Precognition
text: Hero Action: Look at the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is the number of side schemes in the victory display. You may discard 1 of those cards. Put the rest back in any order.

name: Telekinetic Blast
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each side scheme in the victory display.

name: Technovirus Purge
text:
Victory 0.

flavor: "Now that's how you make an exit!"
name: Maria Hill
text: [star] Interrupt: When Maria Hill thwarts, place the removed threat on your suit form upgrade.

text: Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, advance to stage 2A (the players win by advancing). If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: "I'm not your bro." —Jessica Jones
name: Shakedown
text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.

flavor: WHOOOSH!
name: Innate Perception
text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 THW.

flavor: PA-PA_POW!
name: Innate Inspiration
text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.

flavor: The facepaint Echo applies is in remembrance of her late father's last touch.
name: Echo
text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.

flavor: "I'm sure the nice old Estonian couple that owns this place won't mind if we crash here for a bit." —Jessica Jones
name: Lay Low
text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.

name: Mitigated Threat
text: Attach to a card. Attached card loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon. Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.

name: Luke Cage
text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, he takes 1 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough).

name: Luke Cage
text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Burstein Process upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

flavor: "I'm here, and I'm not going anywhere."
name: Jessica Jones
text: [star] Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for each tough status card on your identity (to a maximum of +4 THW).

flavor: "It ain't just me. I've got family to back me up." —Luke Cage
name: Harlem's Hero
text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. For each tough status card on Luke Cage, choose a character you control and ready it.

name: Knuckle Sandwich
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may discard a tough status card from Luke Cage to return this event to your hand.

flavor: "This is the greatest city in the world. I will not allow it to fall into chaos." —Luke Cage
name: "Stand with Me!"
text: Hero Action (thwart): Give Luke Cage a tough status card. Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each tough status card on Luke Cage (to a maximum of 5).

name: "Sweet Christmas!"
text: [star] Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each tough status card on Luke Cage. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with you.

flavor: "Busted a lot of punching bags at this old place, and they never kicked me out." —Luke Cage
name: Fogwell's Gym
text: Response: After a tough status card is discarded from a [[Defender]] character, exhaust Fogwell's gym → ready that character.

flavor: "I got skin like steel and muscles to match." —Luke Cage
name: Burstein Process
text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Burstein Process → give Luke Cage a tough status card (2 tough status cards instead if he has none).

name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
text: Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion. Attacks against attached minion deal 2 additional damage and gain overkill. Response: After you play this card, engage attached minion.

name: Metal Bracer
text: Luke Cage gets retaliate 1. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Luke Cage, exhaust Metal Bracer → reduce that damage by 1.

flavor: "Tremble before the power of Power Man! That sounded weird. Luke Cage. Tremble before Luke Cage." —Luke Cage
name: Power Man
text: Hero Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, exhaust Power Man → draw a card.

flavor: "I've forgotten more about fighting than you'll ever know." —Iron Fist
name: Iron Fist
text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.

flavor: "Come on, heroes. We've got to help save this city."
name: Misty Knight
text:
Toughness.
[star] Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.

name: Valkyrie
text: Toughness. Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.

flavor: "It takes a lot more than that to keep me down." —Luke Cage
name: Take a Stand
text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.

name: Innovation
text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.

name: The Power of Leadership
text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

name: Defensive Formation
text: Uses (3 block counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.

flavor: "No more running." —Daredevil
name: Righteous Purpose
text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.

name: Hulk
text: Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here. Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.

flavor: "You interrupted my workout."
name: She-Hulk
text: Toughness. Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.

name: Dynamic Duo
text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)

name: Power Man and Iron Fist
text: Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.

name: Unbreakable Bond
text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

name: Energy
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Genius
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Strength
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Internal Injury
text: Give to the Luke Cage player. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, take 3 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough status cards). Alter-Ego Response: After you recover, remove Internal Injury from the game.

name: Cottonmouth
text:
[star] Forced Response: After Cottonmouth attacks, he attacks the same character 2 additional times. (Limit once per phase.) (Luke Cage's nemesis minion.)
[star] Boost: Deal this card to the Luke Cage player as a facedown encounter card.

name: Venomous Whispers
text:
Each [[Serpent Society]] minion cannot be attacked. When Defeated: The defeating player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Serpent Society]] minion is discarded and reveals that minion.
[star] Boost: You are confused.

name: Augmented Jaws
text: Attach to Cottonmouth. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy attacks a character, discard each tough status card from that character. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.

flavor: "You deserve a taste of venom!"
name: Asp
text:
[star] Forced Response: After Asp schemes against you, you are stunned.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

name: Sidewinder
text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When Sidewinder is attacked, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card has a "Boost" ability, deal Sidewinder to the attacking player as a facedown encounter card.

flavor: "Puny runt!" —Hulk
name: Size Advantage
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).

flavor: "There are other ways to see." —Daredevil
name: Observe
text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.

name: Toughen Up
text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.

name: Black Belt
text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.

name: Ronan the Accuser
text:
Toughness. Ronan the Accuser cannot be stunned. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, Ronan the Accuser engages the hero with the fewest remaining hit points.
[star] Boost: Put Ronan the Accuser into play engaged with you.

name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
text:
Forced Response: After a friendly character is defeated by an enemy attack, place 2 threat on the main scheme.
[star] Boost: Put Judge, Jury, Executioner into play.

name: The Accused
text:
Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy initiates an attack against the attached identity, that enemy gets +1 ATK for the attack. Forced Response: After Ronan the Accuser is defeated, discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach to your identity.

name: Bring the Hammer Down
text:
When Revealed: Ronan the Accuser activates against the player he is engaged with. If Ronan the Accuser is not in play, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If this activation defeats a character, deal the first player 1 facedown encounter card.

name: You Dare Oppose Me?
text:
When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Each time a card belonging to the Kree Fanatic set is discarded this way, deal that card to yourself as a facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, that attack gains overkill.
